```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow mainFlow) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileScreen 'Contact' ***/
    var contact2 = mainFlow.CreateScreen("Contact");
    var eSpace = mainFlow.GetESpace();
    var registered = eSpace.SystemRoles.OfType<OutSystems.Model.Logic.ISystemRole>().Named("Registered");
    contact2.Roles.Add(registered);
    contact2.Description = null; // default value
    contact2.PageName = "contact";
    contact2.SetTitle("\"Contact\"");
    contact2.OnDestroy.Destination = null; // default value
    contact2.OnReady.Destination = null; // default value
    contact2.OnRender.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var saveOnClick = contact2.CreateScreenAction("SaveOnClick");
    saveOnClick.Description = null; // default value
    
    var startNode = saveOnClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var saveContact = saveOnClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteServerActionNode>("SaveContact");
    var saveContact2 = eSpace.ServerActions.Named("SaveContact");
    saveContact.Action = saveContact2;
    saveContact.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    saveContact.VerticalPosition = 3200;
    startNode.Target = saveContact;
    
    var showToast = saveOnClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ShowToast");
    var showToast2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("ShowToast");
    showToast.Action = showToast2;
    showToast.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    showToast.VerticalPosition = 4100;
    saveContact.Target = showToast;
    
    var endNode = saveOnClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    showToast.Target = endNode;
    contact2.OnInitialize.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var layoutMainInstance = contact2.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    layoutMainInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Layouts = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Layouts");
    var demoLayouts = mOD_DEMO_Layouts.MobileFlows.Named("DemoLayouts");
    var layoutMain = demoLayouts.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("LayoutMain");
    layoutMainInstance.SourceBlock = layoutMain;
    var hasFixedHeader = layoutMain.InputParameters.Named("HasFixedHeader");
    layoutMainInstance.SetArgumentValue(hasFixedHeader, "True");
    
    var placeholderContentWidget = layoutMainInstance.PlaceholdersContent.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Placeholder?.Name == "MainContent");
    var footerInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    footerInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var commonFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("Common");
    var footer = commonFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Footer");
    footerInstance.SourceBlock = footer;
    var eventHandler1 = footerInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "Clicked");
    eventHandler1.Handler = saveOnClick;
}
```
